esper: Photographic zoom; the image is a two-dimensional source.
glcells: Two-dimensional cellular growth drawn in the screen plane.
glslideshow: Photographic slideshow; no scene depth is present in the source pictures.
lockward: Orthographic polarized display patterns, without a perspective scene camera.
mapscroller: Two-dimensional map tiles; no elevation or perspective camera.
noof: Orthographic flower patterns accumulated in a two-dimensional image.
photopile: Photographic cards laid out with an orthographic camera; photographs have no depth input.
